# `gcp.vpntunnel`

VPN tunnel resource.

[compute](README.md) · [all services](../README.md)

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Service | compute |
| Scope | regional |
| Asset type | `compute.googleapis.com/VpnTunnel` |
| Tier | 1 (ruled: encoder (encoders/vpn_tunnel.go.tmpl) parses targetVpnGateway only to d.Set Terraform's project and region when they are unset, and returns the body unchanged. region is a url segment here, filled from configuration or the instance. THE BOUNDED GAP: region is not inferred from the gateway.
post_create (post_create/labels.tmpl) calls setLabels after the insert, because compute's insert drops labels (observed on addresses, 2026-09-25). setLabels is this type's labels setter, and a create whose read-back lacks them calls it (gcprov.setAfterCreate). vpnTunnels publish no patch, so every other change replaces the tunnel.
) |
| Mutation timeout | 600s |
